kurz: Egg yolk, cheese and bacon fat are bound with pasta water into a creamy sauce without the egg turning into scrambled egg.
bild_im_kopf: Like walking a tightrope over a pan: warm enough to bind, cool enough that nothing curdles.

schluesselmomente.warum: The fat melts out and later becomes part of the sauce; the bacon turns crisp.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Mix egg yolks with pecorino and plenty of pepper
schluesselmomente.warum: The cheese disperses in the yolk and helps bind later.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Add the pasta with a little pasta water to the bacon and take the pan off the heat
schluesselmomente.warum: Egg yolk sets from about 65–70 °C. Off the flame the sauce stays below that.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Stir in the egg mixture and toss hard until the sauce is glossy
schluesselmomente.warum: Starch from the [[w-pasta|pasta]] water binds fat, egg and cheese into an [[emulsion|emulsion]].
